final.memo:
Soho House occupies a unique position as a global membership platform, yet its public market presence is marred by structural complexity and concerns regarding the influence of controlling shareholders [D01]. While the company has demonstrated membership growth of 13% and delivered a positive operating quarter, the persistent GAAP losses, negative tangible book equity, and ongoing capital-intensive expansion necessitate a rigorous re-evaluation of its governance [D02, D03]. 

The current environment, characterized by whispers of privatization, presents a classic risk for minority holders [D05]. Without an independent committee, there is no guarantee that a transaction will be conducted fairly or that it will reflect the intrinsic value of the membership brand rather than the short-term interests of insiders [D01, D05].

We are moving to ESCALATE to ensure that any potential change in control is handled through a transparent, competitive process that protects our investment. We demand the immediate appointment of an independent special committee to oversee all strategic alternatives, ensuring that the path to a fair outcome is not obscured by governance structures [D01, D07].
